reviews.review:
The good:
It's very pretty.

The bad:  
Everything else about this piece of trash.  

The combat is particularly terrible, forcing you into this over the shoulder view where the player covers almost half the screen and you can't see what's going on.  The guns are all very boring and feel shallow and fake.  The special powers are all really boring, standard stuff we've seen a million times already.  The companions are always in the way, like if you need to duck behind cover, you can't, because your companions are already there, blocking you from getting away from some bullets etc and then you die.  Or if you need to run out from cover to shoot at an enemy, you can't because the other sidekick is on that side of you and blocking you in.  The sidekicks are really awful and not optional.  If I could just turn them off and play the game solo, maybe I could get past some of the combat.

The 'SAM' ai sidekick thing never shuts up, every time you walk literally 5 feet in the game it has something to say about whether it's cold or dangerously cold outside, talking right over important narrative.  It's really impossible to explain just how annoying that is.  Can't be turned off either.  

The space exploration angle is really bad too, barely there. You click a spacemap screen a couple times and that's it.  Freelancer did it way better decades ago, and somehow looked better in the process.  There is no space combat at all.

This game has rebooted my computer 4 times so far.  I think it's related to the physics being computed on the GPU/Cuda cores, because when i went into my GPU config and set that as disabled (computed on CPU instead) and to override the games settings, that seemed to help.  

It comes with mandatory spyware that must be running in order for the game to function.  It will try to set itself up to run every time you start up your computer from now on.

I thought if I gave this game a couple years past launch to iron out the bugs, maybe I could enjoy it.  But most of these issues aren't bugs, they're just terrible planning and a total disregard for the gamer.  They already got the gamers money,  this is a game for pretty screenshots and nothing else.

DO NOT BUY.

Only have a 11 hours so far but I'm having a blast. Some of the planets are really pretty to look at and the dialogue is mostly pretty good with a few laughs here and there. Ryder to me is just a younger and more cocky version of Shepard.
Awesome game! simply great graphics, addictive story line, this game is a must Play!

If you get this game, try to get it around 9$, it is not worth more then that. The bugs are still there after all this time... the conversations between everyone seem's like the average five year old thought up.
Love this game its so graphically stunning and immersive!
nothing like the first or second mass effect, feels empty and forced.
